goal: Build the scoped caller roster with per-campaign performance, active/inactive status as an Admin action, and auto-promotion of an eligible staff user on first assignment — with no invite, add, import, or user-management control.
outcome: The Callers screen lists the roster in the viewer's scope (Admin = program; Preacher = their assignees plus themselves; Assistant = their preacher's assignees plus themselves) with per-campaign performance from campaign_progress; there is no add, invite or import control; an inactive caller is excluded from pickers and refused at the disposition write, never reactivated; assigning an eligible staff user creates the dialer_callers row with promoted_by = assigner.

requirements.statement: There is NO add, invite, import or manage-user control; both header buttons were removed on purpose (UX-DR32). Do not re-add one because an older screenshot had it.
PROMOTION: assigning an eligible staff user creates the dialer_callers row with promoted_by = assigner. Never create public.users or auth.users.
Performance columns come from campaign_progress (story 1.9), not a client-side count and not a second query shape.
Deactivation and reactivation are an Admin action only.
